preconditions.description: The length of string S is between 1 and 10^5.
The length of string T is between 1 and 10^5.
The number of queries is between 1 and 10^5.
The start and end indices of the source substring for each query are valid.
The start and end indices of the target substring for each query are valid.

postconditions.description: The output is a string of length Q, where each character is either '1' or '0'.
The i-th character of the output is '1' if it is possible to transform the substring S[ai..bi] into T[ci..di] using the given transitions, otherwise it is '0'.
